text: The access-side gate is served by three new operations on the base /api/recovery/access/v1: POST /admin/service-level-loads (multipart part file plus query validFrom), POST /admin/service-level-loads/{loadId}/approve (form field decision) and GET /admin/service-level-loads/{loadId}; the consumed case-service operations are proposed as POST /admin/service-levels, POST /admin/service-levels/{loadId}/approve and GET /admin/service-levels/{loadId} on the base /api/recovery/case/v1, and every call is one hop with a 2 s timeout and a breaker.
